description: Canonical symptom information fields used by the Symptom Communication Assistant.

main_symptom.description: The patient's main symptom or sensation in their own words.

site.description: Where the patient experiences the symptom.

onset.description: When the symptom began and, when volunteered, whether onset was sudden or gradual.

character.description: How the patient describes the quality or sensation.

radiation.description: Whether the symptom stays in one location or spreads or moves elsewhere.

associated.description: Other patient-reported experiences occurring around the same time.

timing.description: The duration, frequency, or temporal pattern of the symptom.

exacerbating.description: Patient-reported factors that make the symptom worse.

relieving.description: Patient-reported factors that make the symptom better.

severity.description: Patient-reported symptom intensity using a 0 to 10 scale when appropriate.
